items.name: liquid-logo

items.description: WebGL2 canvas that renders a logo with a liquid distortion shader. Helper files split into liquid-logo-parse.ts (image processing / PDE solver) and liquid-logo-shader.ts (GLSL sources). Vue watchers for prop changes converted to a useEffect calling updateUniforms.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Three variants: AnimatedLogoCloud (CSS marquee scroll of logo images), IconLogoCloud (icon grid), and StaticLogoCloud (static grid). All exported from a single file. CSS @keyframes logo-cloud injected via style tag.

items.name: logo-origami
items.title: Logo Origami
items.description: Flip-card origami animation cycling through children at a configurable interval. Vue slots mapped to a ReactNode[] prop. motion-v Motion component replaced with motion/react motion.div. Includes LogoOrigamiItem helper component.

items.name: inspira-marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Horizontally or vertically scrolling marquee that repeats children N times. Supports reverse direction and pause-on-hover. Includes ReviewCard sub-component. CSS @keyframes marquee / marquee-vertical injected via style tag.

items.name: inspira-meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: CSS-animated meteor shower effect rendering N randomly positioned spans with rotation + fade keyframe animation. Random values computed once via useMemo to avoid recalculating on every render. Keyframes injected via a style tag.

items.name: morphing-tabs
items.title: Morphing Tabs
items.description: Tab bar with a gooey SVG filter effect — adjacent tabs appear to morph together when the active tab is marked with expanded margins. Ported Vue `<script setup>` props/emits to typed React props with onTabChange callback. SVG filter inline in JSX.

items.name: inspira-morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.description: Cycles through an array of text strings using a blur-based cross-fade morph effect driven by requestAnimationFrame. All Vue refs and onMounted/onUnmounted lifecycle hooks converted to useRef + useEffect with cleanup. SVG threshold filter embedded inline.

items.name: inspira-multi-step-loader
items.title: Multi-Step Loader
items.description: Full-screen overlay loader that walks through sequential steps with timing, optional async steps, completion callbacks, and animated step icons. Vue watch/emit/timer logic converted to useEffect + useRef for timer management. Framer-motion AnimatePresence replaces Vue Transition.

items.name: neon-border
items.title: Neon Border
items.description: Container with a two-color neon glowing border using CSS filter drop-shadow and absolute positioned gradient layers. Vue v-bind CSS variables for dynamic color/duration replaced with inline React styles. Supports none/half/full animation width and configurable duration.

items.name: inspira-number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Animated number counter that triggers when scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver). Replaces @vueuse/core useTransition + useElementVisibility with a hand-rolled requestAnimationFrame loop and inline easing functions matching the VueUse TransitionPresets. Supports up/down direction, delay, decimal places, and locale formatting.

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: Wraps children in a continuously orbiting animation using CSS keyframes injected via a style tag. Vue scoped CSS v-bind for radius/duration/delay/direction converted to dynamic keyframe name per radius and inline animation style. Optionally renders an SVG circle path at the orbit radius.

items.name: particle-image
items.title: Particle Image
items.description: Renders an image as an interactive particle field using a canvas-based particle engine (2D or WebGL). The Vue data-attribute bridge pattern preserved — the img element passes all config as data-* attributes which the InspiraImageParticle JS class reads. Helper JS copied verbatim to inspira-image-particles.js and dynamically imported in useEffect.

items.name: particles-bg
items.title: Particles Background
items.description: Canvas-based floating particle background with mouse magnetism. Replaces @vueuse/core useMouse + useDevicePixelRatio with native mousemove event listener and window.devicePixelRatio. All Vue reactive state and watchers converted to useRef (for mutable loop state) and useEffect for lifecycle.

items.name: pattern-background
items.title: Pattern Background
items.description: Animated grid, dot, or big-dot tiling background with directional scroll animation and optional ellipse mask overlay. CVA variant system ported from the Vue index.ts; CSS keyframes injected inline.

items.name: photo-gallery
items.title: Photo Gallery
items.description: CSS diamond clip-path gallery grid that expands hovered images to a rectangle and dims the rest using :has() selector. Scoped styles converted to an injected <style> block.

items.name: inspira-progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: Layered backdrop-filter blur that fades in progressively along a chosen edge (top/bottom/left/right). motion/react Motion divs are used to allow animation prop pass-through matching the Vue motion-v usage.

items.name: radiant-text
items.title: Radiant Text
items.description: Animated shining-highlight paragraph that sweeps a bright radiant band across text using background-clip:text and a CSS keyframe animation. Duration and band width are configurable.

items.name: inspira-rainbow-button
items.title: Rainbow Button
items.description: Button with an animated rainbow gradient border and matching glow beneath via ::before. v-bind CSS variable trick for speed replaced with inline CSS custom property. Supports polymorphic `as` prop.

items.name: inspira-ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: Concentric pulsing circles rendered absolutely inside a container, ported from two Vue SFCs (Ripple + RippleCircle). RippleContainer convenience wrapper also included.

items.name: inspira-ripple-button
items.title: Ripple Button
items.description: Click-triggered ripple effect button. Mouse position is used to spawn animated circle overlays that fade out. Vue watchEffect + ref array converted to useState with setTimeout cleanup.

items.name: safari-mockup
items.title: Safari Mockup
items.description: SVG Safari browser chrome mockup with full toolbar decorations. Accepts `src` for a screenshot image and `url` for the address bar text. Vue {{ url }} template interpolation converted to JSX expression.

items.name: inspira-scales
items.title: Scales
items.description: Repeating linear-gradient pattern background with configurable orientation (horizontal/vertical/diagonal), size, and color. Written at registry/inspira-react/scales.tsx.

items.name: scratch-to-reveal
items.title: Scratch To Reveal
items.description: Canvas-based scratch card that reveals hidden content underneath a gradient overlay. Triggers an animation and onComplete callback when the scratch percentage threshold is met. Written at registry/inspira-react/scratch-to-reveal.tsx.

items.name: scroll-island
items.title: Scroll Island
items.description: Fixed dynamic island that tracks page scroll percentage with an animated circular progress bar and expandable content panel. Uses motion/react spring transitions. Written at registry/inspira-react/scroll-island.tsx.

items.name: shader-toy
items.title: Shader Toy
items.description: WebGL2 shader renderer that runs Shadertoy-compatible GLSL fragment shaders with iTime, iMouse, iResolution, iHSV, and iSpeed uniforms. Pre-existing files reused (shader-toy.tsx + inspira-shader-toy.ts); added shader-toy.demo.tsx. Written at registry/inspira-react/shader-toy.tsx.

items.name: inspira-shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: Button with a conic-gradient shimmer animation that slides and spins within a masked overlay. Configurable shimmer color, speed, border radius, and background. Written at registry/inspira-react/shimmer-button.tsx.

items.name: sleek-line-cursor
items.title: Sleek Line Cursor
items.description: Canvas cursor trail effect that renders multiple spring-physics lines following the mouse with hue-cycling stroke color. Uses Wave and Node simulation classes ported directly from Vue. Written at registry/inspira-react/sleek-line-cursor.tsx.

items.name: inspira-smooth-cursor
items.title: Smooth Cursor
items.description: Motion-spring cursor that replaces the native cursor with a custom SVG icon, rotating in the direction of travel and scaling on movement. Uses useSpring from motion/react. Written at registry/inspira-react/smooth-cursor.tsx.

items.name: snowfall-bg
items.title: Snowfall Background
items.description: Canvas background that animates drifting snowflake particles with configurable color, quantity, speed, and radius. Written at registry/inspira-react/snowfall-bg.tsx.

items.name: inspira-sparkles
items.title: Sparkles
items.description: Canvas-based animated particle field. Particles float and pulsate with configurable color, density, size, and speed. Uses RAF loop + ResizeObserver instead of @vueuse/core.

items.name: inspira-sparkles-text
items.title: Sparkles Text
items.description: Text with animated star sparkles that fade/scale/rotate continuously around it. Framer-motion replaces motion-v animations. Stars regenerate on lifespan expiry.

items.name: inspira-spinning-text
items.title: Spinning Text
items.description: Circular spinning text where each character is positioned radially around a center point. Supports forward/reverse rotation, configurable radius and duration via framer-motion.

items.name: spline
items.title: Spline
items.description: Wraps @splinetool/runtime (dynamically imported) in a responsive container with IntersectionObserver and ResizeObserver. Shows children slot as loading state. Requires @splinetool/runtime to be installed separately.

items.name: spring-calendar
items.title: Spring Calendar
items.description: Animated day-picker calendar with spring physics via framer-motion MotionConfig. Displays upcoming events per day. Includes a TextMorph helper (spring-calendar-text-morph.tsx) that morphs day labels with blur transitions.

items.name: svg-mask
items.title: SVG Mask
items.description: Mouse-follow SVG mask reveal effect. On hover the mask expands to revealSize px revealing a hidden layer beneath. Uses CSS mask-image with the Inspira CDN mask SVG.

items.name: tailed-cursor
items.title: Tailed Cursor
items.description: OGL WebGL multi-ribbon cursor trail. Each ribbon follows the mouse with configurable spring/friction physics, fade, and optional shader wave effect. OGL is dynamically imported.

items.name: testimonial-slider
items.title: Testimonial Slider

items.name: tetris
items.title: Tetris

items.name: text-3d

items.name: inspira-text-generate-effect

items.name: text-glitch

items.name: text-highlight

items.description: Animated background-size expansion that paints a highlight colour across text from left to right, with optional text colour transition at animation end. CSS animations injected inline with per-instance class names.

items.name: inspira-text-hover-effect

items.name: inspira-text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal

items.name: inspira-text-reveal-card

items.name: inspira-timeline

items.name: inspira-tracing-beam
